units.rhetorical_move: grant the old priority, then name two harms

original_instantiations: A system can be introduced as efficient first and only then as damaging.
The opening grants the usual goal and immediately splits the harm in two.

units.source_excerpt: Current food system prioritizes efficiency and profitability while ignoring the sustainability and equity.
units.reusable_pattern: Grant the usual goal in one clause, then split the neglected harm into two named aspects.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat every food paper as opening on efficiency.

units.rhetorical_move: name the three subsystems before the policy

original_instantiations: A production account can be split into planting, animals, and catch before any policy is named.
The preview lists three industries and only then mentions government intervention.

units.source_excerpt: we divide the whole food system into three subsystems (planting, husbandry and fisheries)
units.reusable_pattern: Name the three industries in parentheses before saying what a government intervention would do.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not reuse this triad as the only way to split a food system.

units.rhetorical_move: pair a rich case with a poor case and print the cuts

features.quantitative_role: three percentages then a dollar total
original_instantiations: A forecast can cut three industries by small percentages and then name a freight bill.
The rich case loses a little output and pays a shipment; the poor case gains output.

units.source_excerpt: the food output value of USA's planting, husbandry, and fishery industry will decline 2.1%,1.1% and 1.2% respectively
units.reusable_pattern: Give the rich country's three cuts, then the freight bill, then the poor country's three gains.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat 2.1, 1.1, and 1.2 as a general developed-country result.

units.rhetorical_move: leave the equity keyword misspelled

original_instantiations: A keyword line can keep a swapped vowel in the equity label.
The last label is the equity word with the vowel out of place.

units.source_excerpt: key words : Food system;Production model;Sustainability;Euqity
units.reusable_pattern: End the summary with a semicolon list and leave the equity spelling as printed.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the vowel when imitating this close.

units.rhetorical_move: call food fundamental, then announce severe limits

original_instantiations: A background can call the object fundamental and then say the system is badly limited.
The turn comes on however, after a short praise.

units.source_excerpt: Food is fundamental to human wellbeing, and food production involves all aspects of social life. However, we think the current food system has severe limitations.
units.reusable_pattern: Praise the object in one sentence, then turn on however to a severe limit.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not open every background by calling the topic fundamental.

units.rhetorical_move: borrow a foreign adjective for the uneven map

original_instantiations: The unevenness can be named with a foreign adjective left untranslated.
One harm is damage; the other is a distribution the paper calls uneven in Spanish.

units.source_excerpt: The other is the food distribution is very desigual across continents and regions
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the untranslated adjective in the second harm.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not gloss the borrowed word into a smoother English adjective.

units.rhetorical_move: propose the network, then the voluntary subsidy

original_instantiations: The work list puts a production estimate first and a voluntary subsidy second.
Surplus countries are said to subsidize the deficit countries of their own accord.

units.source_excerpt: countries of food surplus will subsidize the Low-Income Food-Deficit Countries (LIFDCs) voluntarily.
units.reusable_pattern: First the production estimate, then a voluntary subsidy from surplus to deficit.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not describe every equity model as voluntary.

units.rhetorical_move: name the rich case and the poor case in one colon

original_instantiations: A pair of cases can be introduced after a colon, rich then poor.
The sentence names one developed country and one developing country and stops.

units.source_excerpt: we specifically applied the model to two countries: one is the USA, a developed country and the other is Nepal, a developing country.
units.reusable_pattern: After a colon, name the rich country and the poor country in one sentence.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat this pair as the required case design.

units.rhetorical_move: split countries into surplus and deficit, then blame each side

original_instantiations: A stance can sort every country into surplus or deficit and then blame each bin.
The surplus side is blamed for excess and chemicals; the deficit side for thin technology.

units.source_excerpt: We divide all countries into two categories: one is country with surplus food production and the other is country with deficit food production.
units.reusable_pattern: Sort countries into two bins, then attach a different blame to each bin.
reusable_elements: some of the former / some of the latter
prohibited_generalizations: Do not assume every paper bins countries only by surplus and deficit.

units.rhetorical_move: pick one climate as the representative

original_instantiations: A large country can be represented by its single most familiar climate.
The stance also ties the labor growth to the population growth.

units.source_excerpt: we choose the most classic one as a representative for countries with multiple types of climate
units.reusable_pattern: When a country has several climates, keep only the most familiar one.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat one climate as enough for every large country.

units.rhetorical_move: say the help is given for nothing

original_instantiations: A donation stance can say the rich side helps and is paid nothing.
The phrase for nothing carries the price, which is zero.

units.source_excerpt: We assume countries with abundant food production are willing to assist the least developed countries for nothing.
units.reusable_pattern: State the help as willing, and the payment as nothing.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not read for nothing as a general claim that aid is free.

units.rhetorical_move: give every country the same technology rate and the same population rate

original_instantiations: A last stance can put one technology rate and one population rate on every country.
The forecast is allowed to move only because those two rates are shared.

units.source_excerpt: we assume every country shares the same rate of technology progress and population growth.
units.reusable_pattern: Close the list by making the two time rates common to every country.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not export one shared growth rate beyond this forecast.

units.rhetorical_move: refuse to add the three volumes, and switch to value

original_instantiations: Three industries cannot be added in volume, so the paper adds them in money.
The unit conflict is the reason the output becomes a value.

units.source_excerpt: we can't add three industries' volume together directly because the unit is different. So, we calculate the total food production value.
units.reusable_pattern: Refuse the volume sum because the units differ, then switch the output to value.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat value as the only admissible food total.

units.rhetorical_move: misname the network as a feed for the world

original_instantiations: The architecture sentence swaps forward for a phrase about the world.
The same sentence still lists input, one hidden layer, and output.

units.source_excerpt: Our model uses single-layer feed for world neural networks, which is composed of input layer, single hidden layer and output layer
units.reusable_pattern: Keep the swapped name, then list the three layers.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not silently correct the name to feedforward.

units.rhetorical_move: give the hidden layer eight neurons and leave the output activation blank

original_instantiations: The hidden count is eight and uses the ramp function, while the output activation is a blank.
The sentence names the output activation and then does not name it.

units.source_excerpt: The hidden layer contains eight neurons, each of which takes the relu function as the activation function. And, the output layer neuron takes as the activation function.
units.reusable_pattern: State the hidden count and its ramp, then leave the output activation unnamed.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not fill in the missing output activation.

units.rhetorical_move: call the chemical a double-edged sword

original_instantiations: A chemical can be introduced as helpful and harmful in the same sentence.
The limit is justified by saying more is not better.

units.source_excerpt: It is common knowledge that chemical is a double-edged sword.
units.reusable_pattern: Call the input common knowledge, then give it two edges.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not use the sword figure for every harmful input.

units.rhetorical_move: say more is not better

original_instantiations: A cap can be stated as a plain denial that more is better.
Beyond the cap, a further dose is called useless and then lethal.

units.source_excerpt: the use of chemicals is not the more the better. There exists a limit value
units.reusable_pattern: Deny that more is better, then name a limit past which the dose turns useless.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat this cap as a measured agronomic threshold.

units.rhetorical_move: set a quota and misspell the people who fish
units.function: carry the restriction into the third industry

original_instantiations: The same restriction is said to move to grazing and to a catch quota.
The people who fish are named with the vowel wrong.

units.source_excerpt: Governments can give punishments to the farmers engaged in overgrazing and set a fishing quota for fishmen.
units.reusable_pattern: Extend the restriction with a punishment and a quota, and keep the misspelled name.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the name of the people who fish.

units.rhetorical_move: name the initiative and minimize the distance
units.function: turn equity into a shortest path

original_instantiations: Equity is handed to a named initiative whose only criterion is a short haul.
Ten high-possession countries give, and eighteen least-developed countries receive.

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, we propose a Hand-in-Hand Initiative.
units.reusable_pattern: After saying production cannot fix equity, name the initiative and minimize the haul.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat a shortest haul as a complete equity plan.

units.rhetorical_move: send technology and population out to 2100

original_instantiations: Time enters as a technology series and a population series, both run to 2100.
The sentence says until now once those two forecasts exist.

units.source_excerpt: we predict the future changes in ASTI level until 2100. And, according to the United Nations World Population Outlook, we predict the population growth until 2100.
units.reusable_pattern: Add time as two forecasts, each ending in 2100, then say the dynamic model is now in hand.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat 2100 as this paper's only horizon in later sections.

units.rhetorical_move: call the animal forecast unstable and the whole model quite well

original_instantiations: One industry is called unstable and the whole is still called quite well.
The concession comes first and the praise follows on however.

units.source_excerpt: the predicted value of the output value of the husbandry is not stable, but the predicted value of two other industries is close to the actual output value. However, the model performance is quite well on the whole.
units.reusable_pattern: Concede one unstable industry, then call the whole quite well.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not read quite well as a reported error statistic.

units.rhetorical_move: set a criterion and tell the country to approach it

original_instantiations: An index from 1 to 10 is given a criterion, and the optimized path approaches it.
Above the criterion means the country has left sustainability.

units.source_excerpt: So in the optimized system, the Intensity Index of a country should approach the criterion value gradually.
units.reusable_pattern: Define a criterion, then say the optimized index approaches it gradually.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the criterion as a fitted optimum.

units.rhetorical_move: state a dollar total that the next figure's axis does not carry

original_instantiations: A 120 percent rise in chemicals is said to land near a fifty-million-dollar output.
The number is stated as what the production model lets us know.

units.source_excerpt: Nepal's output value maximum is nearly 50 million dollars at current labor and technology level.
units.reusable_pattern: Tie a percentage increase in chemicals to a single dollar total called nearly.
reusable_elements: at current labor and technology level
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the fifty-million figure as confirmed by the axis of the next plot.

units.rhetorical_move: name two distances and one bill

features.quantitative_role: two distances and one dollar total
original_instantiations: Two distances and one donation volume are followed by a single dollar bill.
The receivers are named before the kilometers.

units.source_excerpt: The beneficiary countries from USA is Haiti and Guatemala. The distance between USA and Haiti is 700 kilometers and the distance between USA and Guatemala is 1754 kilometers.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the two receivers, give each distance, then one bill.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not split the bill across the two distances without a printed split.

units.rhetorical_move: say the benefit is large in extent, with the preposition wrong

original_instantiations: A summary can claim a large mitigation and use the wrong preposition.
The benefit is then located in the countries that overuse chemicals.

units.source_excerpt: the new food system can alleviate environmental damage in a large extent
units.reusable_pattern: Claim the mitigation in one clause and keep the preposition as printed.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not correct the preposition to a large extent's usual form.

units.rhetorical_move: name two food sources and then decline to compute the second

original_instantiations: One source is local chemicals and the other is a named donor.
The second source is announced and then not computed, because the sum is the same.

units.source_excerpt: Another increased food source is the donations from Ukraine. Because the calculation is the same, here we do not calculate Ukraine's donations any more.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the second source, then refuse the repeat calculation.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not invent the donation that the paper declines to compute.

units.rhetorical_move: split twenty held-out countries by land area

original_instantiations: A check can hold out twenty countries and split them only by area.
The error is a gap over the actual value, then an average inside each group.

units.source_excerpt: we randomly collected the food output data of another 20 countries that did not participate in the model training
units.reusable_pattern: Hold out a fresh set, split it by area, and score each group by the average relative gap.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat the area split as a full sensitivity design.

units.rhetorical_move: call the model relatively strong because the whole map looked good

original_instantiations: Adaptability is inferred from one earlier map looking good.
The claim is hedged as relatively strong.

units.source_excerpt: On the whole, the model performance is good. So we can say our model has relatively strong adaptability.
units.reusable_pattern: Point at an earlier figure, call it good, then hedge the adaptability as relatively strong.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not promote relatively strong into a measured transfer score.

units.rhetorical_move: trace the data to an official site and claim high reference value

original_instantiations: A strength can rest on the data being official and latest.
Many factors plus an official site are said to give the result high reference value.

units.source_excerpt: The data used in our paper is the most accurate and latest from official website to guarantee the reliability of results.
units.reusable_pattern: Ground the first strength in an official, latest source, then claim reference value.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat an official site as a substitute for a reported error.

units.rhetorical_move: praise the network for one hidden layer and any precision

original_instantiations: The last strength says one hidden layer can match any continuous function to any precision.
Linear models are the comparison class and are called less excellent.

units.source_excerpt: It can approximate a continuous function of any complexity with any precision by only one hidden layer containing enough neurons.
units.reusable_pattern: Praise the network by a universal-approximation claim, then rank it above linear models.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not repeat the universal claim as a result this paper demonstrated.

units.rhetorical_move: blame missing data on probability

original_instantiations: A limit can say the data are hard to get and then name probability as the cause of sample error.
The word probability stands where a word like possibly would have stood.

units.source_excerpt: Some data is difficult to obtain probability causing sample error.
units.reusable_pattern: Own the sample error, and leave probability as the printed cause.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not rewrite probability as possibly.

units.rhetorical_move: call the whole model a bit idealized

original_instantiations: The second limit says several assumptions make the whole model a bit idealized.
The hedge is a bit, not a measured bias.

units.source_excerpt: We set several assumptions so the whole model is a bit idealized.
units.reusable_pattern: Point at the stance list and call the model a bit idealized.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not expand a bit idealized into a list the paper does not give.

units.rhetorical_move: number the sources and leave the list short

original_instantiations: The source list is a short numbered block mixing a hunger entry with journal lines.
Each source keeps its own number and no annotation is added.

units.source_excerpt: [1] M. J. P. L. Dos Santos, Equitable food distribution and sustainable development
units.reusable_pattern: Close with a short numbered list and no commentary under the entries.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not treat this list as a guide to which claim uses which source.
